<set-variable name="bodySelection" value='@{
        var result = new JObject(
            new JProperty("model", ""),
            new JProperty("errorCode", ""));
        try
        {
            var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            var model = body?["model"];
            var stream = body?["stream"];

            if (body == null || (stream != null && stream.Type != JTokenType.Boolean))
            {
                result["errorCode"] = "InvalidRequest";
            }
            else if (model == null || model.Type == JTokenType.Null)
            {
                result["errorCode"] = "ModelNotAvailable";
            }
            else if (model.Type != JTokenType.String)
            {
                result["errorCode"] = "InvalidRequest";
            }
            else
            {
                result["model"] = (string)model;
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            result["errorCode"] = "InvalidRequest";
        }
        result["errorStatus"] = (string)result["errorCode"] == "InvalidRequest" ? 400 : 404;

        return result;
    }' />
    <set-variable name="bodyValidation" value='@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("bodySelection", null)["errorCode"].ToString())' />
    <set-variable name="model" value='@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("bodySelection", null)["model"].ToString())' />
    
        
            
            <set-variable name="errorStatus" value='@((int)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("bodySelection", null)["errorStatus"])' />
